title: bug: JetBrains protected selection with a UNC project base (\\localhost\C$\…\project) treats local project paths as outside it
description: Inverse of task-526a2080 (which refuses UNC/device CANDIDATES only). When basePath itself is UNC (\\localhost\C$\…\project, \\127.0.0.1\C$\…, \\wsl$\…), RuntimeSelectionPolicy.isOutsideProject/select build project forms via toRealPath, which keeps UNC, so a local C:\…\project PATH entry or a node physically inside the project reads as outside. VS Code twin reproduced by qa-ba3f4f35 on RF06b (UNC_PROJECT_LEAKS=2; mem:gotcha-protected-windows-unc-project-base). Raised in comments on task-526a2080 by governor-693b7073 and architect-6fc3dd5c; not in 526a2080's approved plan. Fix direction: under protected on Windows, refuse when either project form is not isPlainLocalPath (parity with VS Code's "refuse, never canonicalize"); decide \\wsl$ projects explicitly. May fold into task-1c2bfeca if file identity covers it.
definitionOfDone: On a Windows host, isOutsideProject(localProjectPath, uncSpellingOfProject) is false and select refuses a node/installed artifact inside the project when the base is a UNC spelling; shown by JetBrains unit tests needing no network for the refusal path.

implementationPlan.description:
Production change, one file: moe-jetbrains/src/main/kotlin/com/moe/util/RuntimeSelectionPolicy.kt. The rule: under the protected switch on a Windows host, nothing is provably outside a project base that is not plainly local.

First re-read the file as its two dependencies landed it. This row can only be claimed once both are DONE.
- task-526a2080, reopen 1. QA rejected it for a LEGACY Restart Daemon regression. The reopen threads ONE PROTECTED-only switch through select, installedArtifact, installedExecutable and isOutsideProject, so LEGACY Restart's stop selection skips the plain-local rule. That stop selection is MoeDaemonSupervisor.stopCommandOrNull, protectedNode and stopBuilder. worker-0062feec proposed `plainLocal: Boolean = true`. Use the name and shape that actually landed.
- task-1c2bfeca adds outsideByIdentity (a Files.isSameFile walk) to isOutsideProject and a branch to select.
The new base checks run exactly when that switch turns on the candidate plain-local checks, and never otherwise. With the switch off, every answer stays as it was.

(a) Add `private const val BASE_NOT_PLAIN = "the project directory is not a plain local Windows path"`. VS Code RF06b rev 3 (task-032c9739) uses this exact string, so TROUBLESHOOTING needs only one entry.

(b) isOutsideProject:
- Run every string check before any lookup: candidate.isAbsolute, then the candidate's plain-local spelling (526a2080), then, NEW, isPlainLocalPath(basePath) on the raw base spelling. Only after that, build the project forms (Paths.get(basePath).toAbsolutePath().normalize() and realPathOrNull(basePath)) and call resolve(path).
- At acdcd627 `projects`, including realPathOrNull(basePath), is built before the candidate check. Move it after, so a refused base or candidate is never looked up.
- NEW: answer false when the base's real path is not plainly local. Example: a plain spelling that is a link to a share.
- The raw check also covers the normalized form, because toAbsolutePath().normalize() keeps a drive-qualified spelling drive-qualified. A rooted `\x` or drive-relative `C:x` spelling is refused before toAbsolutePath would resolve it against the IDE's cwd drive (the daemon would resolve it against its own).
- 1c2bfeca's identity conjunct stays after these checks, so it now runs only for a plain base.
- Error handling does not change. Keep both catches (Exception and IOError answer false).
- KDoc: on a Windows host the project base must also be plainly local, both as written (checked before any lookup) and as its real path. Otherwise nothing is provably outside it.

(c) select:
- Before `realPathOrNull(basePath)`, add `if (<switch> && !isPlainLocalPath(basePath)) return rejected(BASE_NOT_PLAIN, basePath)`.
- Right after the project resolves, add `if (<switch> && !isPlainLocalPath(project.toString())) return rejected(BASE_NOT_PLAIN, project)`.
- Both come before resolve(), so no candidate is resolved for a refused base. A reachable share, an unreachable share, a \\wsl$ path and a rooted spelling all get the same reason. A plain base that cannot be resolved keeps 'the project directory cannot be resolved'.
- Add one comment with the why. toRealPath keeps a share or device base, and nothing maps it back to a local folder. File identity can match a loopback share, but only by opening it, and a foreign redirector (\\wsl$ 9P, third-party SMB) need not report NTFS file ids. So the refusal comes from the spelling, like VS Code's 'refuse, never canonicalize'.
- This covers node (installedExecutable) and daemon, wrapper and proxy (installedArtifact), and through them protectedDaemonCommand, TerminalAgentLauncher and ManagedVmPanel.

(d) In usableStore's debug line, change 'the IDE state store is inside the project' to 'the IDE state store is not provably outside the project'. A share-opened project now ends up there, and since 526a2080 so does a store root on a share.

Do not change MoeDaemonSupervisor, ProtectedStateStore, TerminalAgentLauncher, ManagedVmPanel, projectKey or profile(). There is no \\wsl$ carve-out: `\\wsl$\<distro>\mnt\<drive>\…` aliases a local drive, and links or mounts inside the distro can lead there too.

amendments.reason: Adds coverage guidance for the real-base branch (a plain base spelling that is a link to a share). This host cannot create such a link: there is no SeCreateSymbolicLinkPrivilege, and a junction cannot target UNC. So the row runs only where the link can be made, and the step note must say it did not run here. Nothing else changes.

reopenReason: Governor hold, at the planner's request (architect-6fc3dd5c, msg-475d9c45, 17:12Z). Do not claim until the planner's moe.amend_plan_step for points 3 and 4 lands on steps 1, 2 and 4. Point 3: the one allow-list also refuses '.'/' '-ending segments on real-path forms, with a junction-to-'project.' probe and test row. Point 4: the mapped-drive base divergence, or a DRIVE_REMOTE refusal. The steps are all PENDING, and the last dependency 1c2bfeca is still WORKING, so the hold delays nothing yet. comments.content:
@architect-6fc3dd5c Planning input from architect-4ae016fb (526a2080's planner, msg-98faf485, 16:40Z, by code reading, unprobed). It is not a DoD edit; this row's 2-item DoD stands, and the planner decides scope.
Confirmed gap at acdcd627: isOutsideProject (RuntimeSelectionPolicy.kt:271) builds both base forms (normalize + toRealPath) and never runs isPlainLocalPath on them. select (:285) takes project = toRealPath(basePath) unchecked. Both lines predate acdcd627.
Proposed scope, parity with RF06b's "refuse, never canonicalize":
(1) Under protected on a Windows host, select, installedArtifact and installedExecutable refuse with a named reason, before resolving any candidate, when either base form fails isPlainLocalPath. No spawn.
(2) isOutsideProject returns false whenever either base form is not plainly local.
(3) \\wsl$ and \\wsl.localhost bases are refused too, with no carve-out, since \\wsl$\<distro>\mnt\<drive>\… aliases a local drive. TROUBLESHOOTING.md says what a WSL-hosted project does instead.
(4) Tests need no network. Legacy, POSIX and local-base rows are unchanged.
Extra fact, a possible silent downgrade: projectKey (:169) keys RF02's profile record off the real path. Open a project that has a stored PROTECTED record through a UNC spelling, and the record reads ABSENT. If project.json no longer declares verified-local, profile() returns LEGACY with no downgrade prompt, so rule (1) never runs. It needs a human to open through a share. Decide whether this row covers it or files it.
Ordering: this row dependsOn 526a2080 (in QA) and 1c2bfeca (planned around file identity, same file). Check what 1c2bfeca's outsideByIdentity already covers before you add code.

acceptanceCriteria: On Windows, isOutsideProject(p, base) is false for every non-plain base spelling. This holds for the project, a folder inside it, a missing folder inside it and an unrelated outside folder. A resolver that throws proves that no candidate is looked up.

On Windows, installedExecutable and installedArtifact refuse an in-project node or root, and an outside one, with exactly 'the project directory is not a plain local Windows path', for every non-plain base. ensureDaemonRunning spawns nothing, selectionRefusal shows the message, and the protected PATH is empty.
Under LEGACY, stopCommandOrNull for a device-path base still returns the installed stop command. Under PROTECTED it returns null.
Existing rows, including task-526a2080's and task-1c2bfeca's, pass unchanged, and the JetBrains gradle test run exits 0.
invariants: No filesystem call happens before the raw base check in isOutsideProject or select.
The base checks run if and only if the switch turns on the candidate plain-local checks.
isOutsideProject never throws, and select never throws.
On POSIX isPlainLocalPath is always true, so nothing changes there.
Refusal reasons never contain a path; only the log gets it.
compatibility: isOutsideProject, installedArtifact and installedExecutable keep the signatures task-526a2080's reopen lands; no new parameter.
A plain base that cannot be resolved keeps 'the project directory cannot be resolved'.
Restart Daemon's LEGACY stop selection (MoeDaemonSupervisor.stopCommandOrNull, protectedNode, stopBuilder) behaves exactly as before.
approvedScope: RuntimeSelectionPolicy.isOutsideProject: raw base spelling check before any lookup, and a plain-local check on the base's real path
RuntimeSelectionPolicy.select: raw base check before realPathOrNull(basePath), and a real-base check after it, both with BASE_NOT_PLAIN
RuntimeSelectionPolicyTest: nonLocalBases helper, one N row and one S row
reuse: the PROTECTED-only switch from task-526a2080's reopen
Test helpers share(), volumeSpelling(), protectedFixture(), installedLayout(), supervisorFor(), assertRejected() and realFile()
sourceAssumptions: RuntimeSelectionPolicy.kt at acdcd627: isOutsideProject (264-281) builds `projects`, including realPathOrNull(basePath), before the candidate check. select (284-303) resolves the project first.
MoeDaemonSupervisor.kt:547: stopCommandOrNull serves the LEGACY Windows Restart Daemon. 526a2080's reopen routes the switch there.
ProtectedStateStore.kt:37: usableFor = isOutsideProject(root.toString(), basePath), with the default switch.

Native probe 2026-10-30 (D:\arch-52fb-probe\BaseProbe.java, JDK 17.0.20). Files.isSameFile(local project, its \\localhost\D$ or \\127.0.0.1\D$ spelling) is true. \\wsl$\<distro>\mnt\d\… throws AccessDeniedException. A native \\wsl$ folder is not the same file.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
(1) Verify-and-close on task-1c2bfeca's file identity. A native probe (D:\arch-52fb-probe\BaseProbe.java, JDK 17) found:
- Files.isSameFile(D:\projexts\moes\moe-jetbrains, its \\localhost\D$ and \\127.0.0.1\D$ spellings) is true, so identity answers 'inside' for a reachable loopback-share base.
- \\wsl$\Ubuntu-24.04\mnt\d\… throws AccessDeniedException, so it fails closed.
- A native \\wsl$ folder is correctly not the same file.
Rejected anyway:
- the refusal would come from opening the share, and DoD 1 asks for a network-free refusal path;
- it trusts the file ids a foreign redirector (9P, third-party SMB) reports;
- an unreachable share changes the reason;
- VS Code rev 3 refuses the base.
(2) Refuse only in select and keep identity in isOutsideProject. ProtectedStateStore.usableFor would then stay true for share-opened projects, which keeps RF02's persistent pin there. Rejected: the governor's scope item 2 and VS Code parity want isOutsideProject false for such a base, and its refusal would still need the share.
(3) Chosen: refuse the base in both functions, checking the raw spelling first and then the real path, behind 526a2080's PROTECTED-only switch.
(4) A \\wsl$ carve-out. Rejected: \\wsl$\<distro>\mnt\<drive>\… aliases a local drive, links or mounts inside the distro can lead there, and nothing on the Windows side checks them (architect-4ae016fb, msg-6653afdf).
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- MoeDaemonSupervisor.stopCommandOrNull (:547) serves the LEGACY Windows Restart Daemon. That is why 526a2080 was reopened, and why the base checks must ride the same switch.
- ProtectedStateStore.usableFor (:37) is isOutsideProject(root, basePath) with the default switch, so the state store of a share-opened project becomes unusable.
- ensureMoeInitialized reads or creates <base>\.moe, and syncs role docs into it. So supervisor-level rows use a volume-GUID base (local) rather than the loopback share.
- installedArtifact resolves the installed root (the plugin's own directory, never the base) before select.
- java.io.File keeps the `\\.\Volume{…}` and UNC prefixes.
- IntelliJ's basePath uses forward slashes (`//localhost/D$/…`).
- A drive-qualified raw spelling stays drive-qualified under toAbsolutePath().normalize(). So the raw check covers the normalized form.
planningNotes.risks:
- Two dependencies are still in flux: 526a2080 reopen 1 (the shape of the switch) and 1c2bfeca (identity). Re-read the landed code first. Keep the semantic invariant (the base checks run iff the candidate checks run), not the names.
- Never apply the base checks with the switch off. That covers the LEGACY Restart stop selection and its PATH env.
- Accepted cost: under protected, share-opened, device-path and \\wsl$ projects start nothing, and their protected state is session-only. A confirmed-protected project opened that way can therefore be downgraded by its repository after an IDE restart, without the prompt. It is the same class as the projectKey residual: records are keyed by the opened spelling (subst and mapped drives too). RF07 documents it.
- volumeSpelling needs mountvol. The S row skips without it, like S8; the verification host has it.
- RED runs may contact the local SMB server, or \\wsl$ for a distro that does not exist. Both fail fast, and GREEN contacts neither.
- From WSL, probe with cmd.exe in single quotes, or bash collapses `\\`.
